classification.difficultyReason: Identify the right triangle within the rectangle and reinterpret its diagonal as a base with x as the corresponding altitude. Equate two area expressions for that triangle and solve.

content.prompt: Find the value of $x$. 10 cm is the length of the entire diagonal.

spec.description: An unfilled rectangle with its full rising diagonal and the perpendicular segment from the bottom-right corner to that diagonal.
spec.mathematics: The rectangle sides are 8 cm and 6 cm. Its entire diagonal is 10 cm. The unknown x is the perpendicular height of the lower-right triangle when that diagonal is its base. The foot and right-angle marker are derived from the rectangle coordinates.
spec.answerVisibility: All four source measurement labels are visible; no calculated value is shown.

answer.worked:
The diagonal divides the rectangle into two equal-area triangles.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{bh}{2}\\A&=\frac{8\times6}{2}\\A&=24\text{ cm}^{2}\end{align*}$$
For the same triangle, use the entire diagonal as the base and $x$ as its perpendicular height.
$$\begin{align*}24&=\frac{10x}{2}\\48&=10x\\x&=\frac{48}{10}\\x&=4.8\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
